notes.title: The ApocaShift Playtest is LIVE!
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45398310/6d73573e5e3352c9221196b2add1c5364b878503.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]The ApocaShift Playtest is LIVE! [/b][/p][p]The time has come — you can now jump into the first public playtest of [b]ApocaShift[/b] on Steam!
I’ve been working on this game solo for about 2 years, and it means the world to finally let you all get your hands on it.[/p][p]This build is still [b]very early[/b], so expect some rough edges (especially melee combat, which is still in its first draft). I’ll be rolling out [b]daily updates and fixes[/b] throughout the playtest, so things will keep improving quickly. [b]The playtest will last at[/b] [b]least 2 weeks[/b].[/p][p]Here’s what you can dive into right now:[/p][list][*][p]Base-building[/p][/*][*][p]Combat with scavengers & zombies[/p][/*][*][p]Exploration & early extraction mechanics[/p][/*][*][p]Crafting & survival systems[/p][/*][/list][p]Your feedback is [i]critical[/i] at this stage — please use the in-game feedback button or drop your thoughts in Discord so I can keep shaping the game with your help.
[url="https://discord.gg/YNApjZccde"]Join the Discord to share info[/url][/p][p]Thank you for all the support. Every wishlist, every share, and every bit of feedback pushes ApocaShift closer to the vision I’ve been chasing. Can’t wait to see what you think!
[/p][p]— Jeremy / GrimArc[/p]

notes.title: First Alpha UI Overhaul, new Steam capsule, and Steps towards the first Playtest
notes.content:
[h3]Hey  again everyone! 

ApocaShift now has a professionally made capsule art! I hope you like it and the new logo.[/h3][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45398310/6d73573e5e3352c9221196b2add1c5364b878503.jpg"][/img]
[/p][h1][u]UI UPDATE[/u][/h1][p]I’ve also been working hard on improving the overall [b]UI experience in ApocaShift[/b]. While this isn’t the [i]final[/i] version of the UI, I wanted to give it a big overhaul for the playtest so it feels smoother, more polished, and easier to use while testing.[/p][p]These changes are meant to [b]tide things over until later in development[/b], when the full, permanent UI updated will happen. That means what you’re seeing now is [b]temporary[/b], but it should make menus, navigation, and overall gameplay flow way better during the playtesting stage.[/p][p]Your feedback is [i]super important[/i] here, since it helps me refine what’s working and what needs more love when the final UI update comes around.

Here is a look at a few of the new updated screens.
[/p][h2][u]The Building menu[/u][/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45398310/c63eea0f7e5f8d99670c44740ec97c9f94794281.png"][/img][/p][h2][u]Player Inventory[/u][/h2][h2][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45398310/49953af4d6e712bc3d2343a3d1676e3a2a2294ae.png"][/img][/h2][h2][u]The crafting interface.[/u]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45398310/8e3082aabdafe31847d0a98052a3454bb315670e.png"][/img][/h2][h1][u]PLAYTEST ANNOUNCEMENT[/u][/h1][h3]Alongside that, I’m pushing toward the [b]first playtest[/b]. Here’s the list I’ve been working on, and where things stand so far as I plan on releasing the playtest when I finish this list:[/h3][p][/p][p][strike]Finish scav AI enough so it can be aggroed by other mutant/zombie AI,[/strike][/p][p][strike]Finish Crafting Workbench,[/strike][/p][p][strike]Finish spawning hidden stashes as well as finish their loot generation.[/strike][/p][p][strike]Add Scav AI spawning into the world,[/strike][/p][p]Add loot to Scav ai (50% done),[/p][p][strike]Rework some UI menus and finish deposit resources menu with "deposit all" button,[/strike][/p][p][strike]Update quest UI menu,[/strike][/p][p][strike]Add about 10 more quests (Added about 5 more will have more over time),[/strike][/p][p][strike]Update deploy screen to use the actual map,[/strike][/p][p]Rework trader buy prices for scavenged items (0% done),[/p][p]Add options menu and sound adjustments (0% done),[/p][p][strike]Rework item cost for building items so everything isn't free,[/strike][/p][p][strike]Add quest rewards,[/strike][/p][p]Add beginning of Tech Tree and allow saving of it (0% done),[/p][p]Make sure all food and drink items work and spawn properly (0% done),[/p][p][strike]Rework Zombie Loot (Made where they drop every item but ver low odds for anything but common),[/strike][/p][p][strike]Sound radius for guns to attract enemies,[/strike][/p][p]Add bullet wound effects and pictures to the health menu (0% done),[/p][p]Finish up health system and using healing items (0% done),[/p][p][strike]Add Switching between main and secondary weapon (Scope has changed since equipping is now different),[/strike][/p][p][strike]Fix camera jumping when deploying/extracting,[/strike][/p][p][strike]Fix bug where gun sound doesnt play when moving and shooting quickly,[/strike][/p][p]Add more loot spawns to the map,[/p][p][strike]Optimize Zombie Spawning.[/strike][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]I’m almost through this checklist, which means the [b]first playtest is right around the corner[/b]. If you’d like to take part and chat with the community, join the Discord here: [url="https://discord.gg/zacQAcdVqs"]https://discord.gg/zacQAcdVqs[/url][/p]

notes.title: Blood and Gore Update
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45398310/2db9a9a901e4e800658c53b5884e2141e2958290.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]Hello everyone![/h2][p]Today’s update brings some serious visual upgrades. I've added brand new random blood and gore effects that make every fight feel unique and intense. On top of that, bullets are now much easier to see in action, giving you better clarity during combat.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="ZP_4dFEt8nw;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]Blood now sprays out in completely random patterns every time. No two gunfights or zombie killings will ever look the same. Depending on how you hit enemies, blood can splatter, soak the ground, or mist into the air. It’s chaotic, it’s gory, it feels right at home in the world of ApocaShift.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="uwmEeakQIRc;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]I also gave some love to the bullets. They’ve been updated with a more noticeable design so you can clearly tell what you're shooting at in the middle of the action. Whether you're snapping off quick shots or unloading with a heavier weapon, you'll actually [i]see[/i] the round flying toward your target.

[/p][previewyoutube="90sMbfhO5RA;full"][/previewyoutube][p]These changes are all about one thing, better feel during combat. You pull the trigger, you get the feedback. It’s visceral. It's clear. It's satisfying.[/p]

notes.title: ApocaShift - KickStarter Announcement and Summer Update
notes.content:
[p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45398310/1a227d21730f3e2979534fdac5f49f604530693a.png"][/img][/p][h1][b]Summer ApocaShift Update[/b][/h1][h3][b]So much as been added and this might be the largest update yet as i push for a fun and playable build![/b]
[/h3][h2][b]🔧 Major Features & Changes:[/b][/h2][list][*][p][b]Storage Overhaul:[/b]
Items are now stored inside [b]buildable storage containers[/b] instead of a centralized stash. You must walk up to these containers and use the new [b]vicinity looting system[/b] to access their contents.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Zombie AI Rework:[/b]
Zombies now [b]shamble and idle[/b] until they [b]see or hear the player[/b]. Behavior is more natural and reactive.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Screamer Zombies Added:[/b]
These special infected will [b]alert and aggro nearby zombies[/b] when disturbed—be careful![/p][/*][*][p][b]More Special Zombies Coming Soon:[/b][/p][list][*][p][i]Chargers[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Smoke Zombies[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Acid Zombies[/i]
[i](Currently in development)[/i][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Train System Implemented:[/b]
A train is now used for [b]deploying and extracting from raids[/b]. Eventually, it will become a [b]late-game mobile base[/b], which can be repaired, maintained, and driven around the map.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Ammo Management:[/b]
Ammo now [b]takes up inventory space[/b], adding another layer of realism and challenge.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Survival Status Indicators:[/b]
Indicators for [b]Hunger, Thirst, and Bleeding[/b] have been added.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Medical System Rework:[/b]
The healing system has been redesigned to better reflect tactical and survival gameplay.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Hostile Bandit AI (WIP):[/b]
Bandits are being developed with hostile behaviors, expect gunfights and ambushes in future builds.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Custom Radio Stations:[/b]
You can now switch between several [b]radio stations[/b], including:[/p][list][*][p]Ambient[/p][/*][*][p]Oldies[/p][/*][*][p]Rock[/p][/*][*][p]Punk Rock[/p][/*][*][p]Synth[/p][/*][*][p]Classical[/p][/*][*][p]Country[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Weapon Carry Animations:[/b]
Added [b]carrying animations for all two-handed guns[/b], improving realism and immersion.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Fire & Burning Effects:[/b]
Fire effects have been added, enemies and objects can now [b]burn[/b] under the right conditions.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Early Farming System:[/b]
Basic [b]farming at your base[/b] is now possible, laying the groundwork for future survival mechanics.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][previewyoutube="vHyKVY4XwTA;full"][/previewyoutube][h2][b]🛠️ Next Planned Features[/b][/h2][p]Here’s a look at what’s coming next in [i]ApocaShift[/i]:[/p][list][*][p][b]Technology Tree[/b]
Unlock upgrades, structures, and survival advancements through a [b]progression-based tech system[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]Crafting System[/b]
Gather resources and materials to [b]craft tools, weapons, gear, and survival essentials[/b], as well as use [b]buildable machines and workstations[/b] to create [b]higher-tier items[/b] and advanced equipment.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Cooking Mechanics[/b]
Prepare food using [b]raw ingredients and recipes[/b], with [b]hunger/thirst[/b] and potential buffs in mind.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Mining System[/b]
[b]Extract raw resources[/b] like metal, stone, and fuel from the environment to support crafting, construction, and tech upgrades.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45398310/5426be80411970288dce42ae0e9d9d31d2859d7b.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]KICKSTARTER ANNOUNCEMENT[/b][/h2][p]I’m hard at work putting the [i]ApocaShift[/i] Kickstarter together and hope to have it ready to launch by the end of this month. Can’t wait to share it with you all![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45398310/8c7e9b0ba818ba7e404aa32cdb49b91c844622a2.png"][/img][/p][p]Thanks everyone for all your support![/p][p]Here's a base my friend built in game I wanted to show off![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45398310/8d294658be58808ff21f2c0d0a1269776e044079.png"][/img][/p][p]And now finally a base I made.  [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45398310/37d91139592550e332c8f05f9517529fc40c428b.png"][/img]  [/p]

notes.title: ApocaShift Development Update - Base building and other additions
notes.content:
I have some exciting news to announce! The new base building system is implemented and working! 

While there is only a few options here to choose from, I plan on having hundreds of different items / decorations / fauna / floors / buildings to choose from and cant wait to see some of the creations that are made.

[previewyoutube=y2igZXrREQw;full][/previewyoutube]

I still have to add the buildings actually using resources you collected when they are constructed, but I will show this off more when it is fully implemented.

Also i have finished all the backend code for the NPC menus. Many of these menus are Alpha stage and do not have any of the UI assets skinned onto them so don't be too appalled by them now! I promise they'll look better.

[previewyoutube=MfhmAsSQvIo;full][/previewyoutube]

5 new zombie variants added now having 6 total as well as over 30 different clothes for zombies.

[previewyoutube=cZ9LJdvrjKI;full][/previewyoutube]

and lastly different wild animals have been added!
